note.text: Question: how much of the selected EUR 9,000 payment can be assigned to the final EUR 7,000 payout? The ledger records movements, but does not identify which fungible units funded each payment. The model assigns between EUR 4,500 and EUR 7,000 to the final payout. Compare the complete endpoint allocations; do not sum marginal maxima.
